title: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
title_zh: Diff Diffusion：利用扩散模型预测编辑路径，实现高效代码编辑

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning
paragraphs.zh: 扩散语言模型：基础、效率与推理

paragraphs.en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion , a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 × \times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in natural language understanding and generation, and have gradually extended this success to code intelligence tasks. Beyond the autoregressive (AR) paradigm, diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have become a promising alternative because they support parallel decoding and faster generation [ 2 , 22 ] . By progressively denoising discrete noise tokens, dLLMs provide parallel generation capabilities and can make more efficient use of modern hardware computation. In terms of task performance, proprietary systems such as Mercury, Gemini Diffusion, and Seed Diffusion, as well as open-source projects such as DiffuCoder and Dream-Coder, have demonstrated competitive code-related capabilities [ 18 , 13 , 38 , 12 , 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自然语言理解和生成方面取得了显著进展，并逐渐将这一成功扩展到代码智能任务中。 除了自回归（AR）范式之外，基于扩散的大型语言模型（dLLM）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，因为它们支持并行解码和更快的生成速度 [ 2 , 22 ] 。 通过逐步消除离散噪声标记中的噪声，dLLM 提供了并行生成能力，并能更高效地利用现代硬件的计算资源。 在任务表现方面，Mercury、Gemini Diffusion 和 Seed Diffusion 等专有系统，以及 DiffuCoder 和 Dream-Coder 等开源项目，均已展现出具有竞争力的代码相关能力 [ 18 , 13 , 38 , 12 , 45 ] 。

paragraphs.en: However, current dLLMs mainly rely on masked diffusion to regenerate sequences from scratch, which does not match real programming workflows. In actual development, developers more often edit and refine existing code, and the changes are often small, local, and context-dependent. In IDE edit-prediction tasks, the system needs to predict one or more next code modifications in real time based on the user’s edit history, the current file, and the rewrite range around the cursor. This latency-sensitive workflow is illustrated in Figure 1 . Autoregressive models must serially output many unchanged fragments token by token in this task, cannot go back to correct already generated content, and are not well suited to processing multiple edits in parallel; masked diffusion often needs to denoise an entire sequence even when only a small change is required. Over the past year, a number of works on discrete diffusion and discrete flow matching have discussed token insertion, modification, and deletion [ 38 , 43 , 23 , 49 , 15 , 21 , 11 , 44 , 35 ] . However, they do not formulate edit operations as source-conditioned edit-path diffusion for latency-critical editing tasks, where unchanged source tokens should be preserved and skipped while only a few regions are revised.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当前的 dLLM 主要依赖掩码扩散方法从头再生序列，这与实际的编程工作流程并不匹配。 在实际开发中，开发者更常编辑和精炼现有代码，且这些改动通常规模小、具有局部性并依赖上下文。 在 IDE 的编辑预测任务中，系统需要根据用户的编辑历史、当前文件以及光标周围的改写范围，实时预测一个或多个接下来的代码修改。 这种对延迟敏感的工作流程在图 1 中有详细说明。 在此任务中，自回归模型必须逐令牌串行输出大量未更改的片段，无法返回修正已生成的内容，也不适合并行处理多个编辑；而掩码扩散方法即使只需要进行微小改动，也常常需要对整个序列进行去噪。 在过去一年中，多项关于离散扩散和离散流匹配的研究探讨了令牌的插入、修改和删除问题 [38, 43, 23, 49, 15, 21, 11, 44, 35]。 然而，这些研究并未将编辑操作表述为针对延迟敏感编辑任务的源条件编辑路径扩散方法——在这种任务中，未更改的源令牌应当被保留并跳过，而只有少数区域需要被修改。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we propose Diff Diffusion , a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code edit prediction. In addition to modeling variable-length generation with inserted and deleted tokens, Diff Diffusion builds edit-path prediction from the initial state and optimizes around low-latency inference. Unlike existing masked diffusion methods, Diff Diffusion explicitly models edit paths and predicts the sequence of edit operations required to transform an original code snippet into the revised code. By incorporating structured edit representations into the diffusion process, the framework avoids redundant regeneration and instead focuses on local updates. We also design a multi-stage training paradigm to progressively strengthen edit-prediction ability, and propose parallel decoding and inference-system optimization strategies to accelerate inference while maintaining accuracy. We first validate public edit-prediction ability on the C3PO open edit-prediction benchmark, then construct a dedicated edit-prediction evaluation benchmark to analyze improvements on Stay, Act, Multi-line, Roll-back, Delete, and other specific metrics, and finally validate the method in production.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出了 Diff Diffusion——一个受扩散模型启发的 LLM 框架，用于代码编辑预测。 除了通过插入和删除标记来建模变长生成外，Diff Diffusion 还从初始状态构建编辑路径预测，并围绕低延迟推理进行优化。 与现有的掩码扩散方法不同，Diff Diffusion 显式地建模编辑路径，并预测将原始代码片段转换为修订后代码所需的编辑操作序列。 通过将结构化的编辑表示融入扩散过程，该框架避免了冗余的再生成，转而专注于局部更新。 我们还设计了一种多阶段训练范式，以逐步增强编辑预测能力，并提出了并行解码和推理系统优化策略，在保持准确性的同时加速推理。 我们首先在 C3PO 开放编辑预测基准上验证了公开编辑预测能力，然后构建了一个专门的编辑预测评估基准，以分析 Stay、Act、Multi-line、Roll-back、Delete 及其他特定指标上的改进，最后在生产环境中验证了该方法。

paragraphs.en: Conventional masked diffusion randomly masks a subset of tokens and trains the model to recover them through iterative denoising. Edit prediction has a different objective: rather than recovering a full program fragment from a corrupted sequence, the model should transform an existing snippet into its revised form. We therefore define a diff-based diffusion process, in which the denoising trajectory is represented by edit operations. In addition to ordinary token prediction, the model predicts insertion, deletion, and replacement actions that explicitly define the edit path.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的掩码扩散模型会随机掩码一部分词元，并通过迭代去噪训练模型恢复这些词元。 编辑预测的目标则不同：模型无需从损坏的序列中恢复完整的程序片段，而应将现有代码片段转换为修订后的版本。 因此，我们定义了一种基于差异的扩散过程，其中去噪轨迹由编辑操作来表示。 除了普通的词元预测外，该模型还预测插入、删除和替换操作，从而明确定义编辑路径。

paragraphs.en: The model assigns an edit label to each token in the current state:
paragraphs.zh: 该模型为当前状态中的每个词元分配一个编辑标签：

paragraphs.en: keep the token unchanged by emitting its token_id ;
paragraphs.zh: 通过输出其 token_id 来保持该 token 不变；

paragraphs.en: delete the token by emitting del_token_id ;
paragraphs.zh: 通过发出 del_token_id 来删除该标记；

paragraphs.en: insert a mask token before the current position by emitting insert_token_id ;
paragraphs.zh: 通过发出 insert_token_id，在当前位置前插入一个掩码标记；

paragraphs.en: replace the current token with a mask token by emitting replace_token_id ;
paragraphs.zh: 通过发出 replace_token_id，将当前的 token 替换为掩码 token；

paragraphs.en: fill a mask token by predicting a code token_id .
paragraphs.zh: 通过预测一个代码 token_id 来填充一个掩码 token。

paragraphs.en: Tokens marked for deletion are removed, and the requested mask tokens are inserted or used as replacements.

paragraphs.en: the predicted tokens are again assigned edit labels;
paragraphs.zh: 预测的标记再次被分配编辑标签；

paragraphs.zh: 已删除的 token 被移除，并引入了新插入的掩码 token。

paragraphs.en: This formulation retains the central benefit of masked diffusion: multiple positions can be updated in parallel. It also extends this benefit from generation to editing, allowing the model to apply edits at several locations in the same diffusion step. Because code edits usually preserve most source tokens and modify only a small region, the number of steps required to reach the target snippet is much smaller than in from-scratch masked diffusion or standard autoregressive generation. paragraphs.en: To support high-volume online edit-prediction requests, we build a dedicated inference engine for Diff Diffusion. Its system design follows recent work on accelerating diffusion language models through block-wise parallel decoding, approximate KV-Cache reuse, and system-level inference optimization [ 38 , 43 , 26 ] . In contrast to general-purpose generation settings, our target is an IDE code-editing task, where the inference engine must reduce the number of edit iterations and translate this reduction into end-to-end latency gains.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持高吞吐量的在线编辑预测请求，我们为 Diff Diffusion 构建了一个专用的推理引擎。 其系统设计遵循了近期通过分块并行解码、近似 KV-Cache 重用以及系统级推理优化来加速扩散语言模型的研究成果 [ 38 , 43 , 26 ] 。 与通用生成场景不同，我们的目标是 IDE 代码编辑任务，其中推理引擎必须减少编辑迭代次数，并将这种减少转化为端到端的延迟提升。

paragraphs.en: AR models must generate the complete target snippet sequentially, whereas Diff Diffusion treats the current code snippet as an editable state. At each diffusion step, the model predicts same , delete , insert , replace , and mask-to-token actions in parallel. Non-mask positions are restricted to remain unchanged or special edit actions, so replacements must go through replace and subsequent mask filling. Block-wise decoding further partitions the rewrite range into local blocks, applies high-confidence edits within each block in parallel, and uses unchanged tokens from the original code as left and right anchors to constrain edit boundaries. In addition, insertion length is adaptive: when the inference engine assigns high confidence to an insertion region, a single insert action can emit several consecutive tokens, preventing long-completion cases from degenerating into token-by-token insertion.
paragraphs.zh: AR 模型必须按顺序生成完整的目标片段，而 Diff Diffusion 则将当前的代码片段视为一个可编辑的状态。 在每个扩散步骤中，模型会并行预测相同、删除、插入、替换以及掩码到标记的动作。 非掩码位置被限制为保持不变或执行特殊编辑动作，因此替换必须通过“替换”操作以及后续的掩码填充来完成。 分块解码进一步将重写范围划分为局部块，在每个块内并行应用高置信度的编辑，并利用原始代码中未更改的标记作为左右锚点来约束编辑边界。 此外，插入长度是自适应的：当推理引擎对某个插入区域赋予高置信度时，单个“插入”动作可以生成多个连续的标记，从而防止长补全情况退化为逐个标记的插入。

paragraphs.en: We use approximate KV-Cache to reuse bidirectional cache during denoising. Diff Diffusion uses two levels of cache optimization. The first level targets stable context within a service request. Edit-prediction requests contain a system prompt, the current file, and historical edit information, so our inference engine reuses KV states for stable prefixes and converged blocks. The second level targets suffix reuse in long-sequence editing. When only a middle region needs to be modified, a large code suffix after the edit point remains unchanged. We therefore follow the idea of PIE and reuse suffix KV states after RoPE position correction [ 16 ] . This strategy is designed for local code edits with long unchanged suffixes, and in our tests it preserves accuracy while providing substantial end-to-end latency gains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用近似 KV-Cache 在去噪过程中复用双向缓存。 Diff Diffusion 采用两级缓存优化。 第一级针对服务请求内的稳定上下文进行优化。 编辑预测请求包含系统提示、当前文件和历史编辑信息，因此我们的推理引擎会复用稳定前缀和已收敛区块的 KV 状态。 第二级针对长序列编辑中的后缀复用进行优化。 当仅需修改中间区域时，编辑点之后的较长代码后缀将保持不变。 因此，我们遵循 PIE 的思路，在 RoPE 位置校正后复用后缀的 KV 状态 [ 16 ] 。 该策略专为包含长不变后缀的局部代码编辑而设计，在我们的测试中，它在保持准确性的同时显著降低了端到端延迟。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Diff Diffusion around the edit-prediction setting targeted by the method. The experiments cover four questions: whether the model learns public edit-completion patterns, whether post-training improves IDE-specific edit-prediction metrics, whether parallel edit decoding reduces inference latency, and whether the latency gains transfer to production traffic. Large-scale edit pretraining and supervised fine-tuning are run on an Ascend 910B cluster; reinforcement-learning training and evaluation are run on NVIDIA H20 GPUs. Our autoregressive baseline is the production edit-prediction model used before the diffusion cutover, trained from Seed-Coder [ 8 ] . It receives the same recent-edit history, file context, and edit range as Diff Diffusion, and generates the revised snippet from left to right. In the IDE edit-prediction evaluation, we also compare with Mercury-Coder, a diffusion-based model from Mercury [ 18 ] , which provides an edit-prediction endpoint. Detailed training and inference settings are provided in Appendix C .

paragraphs.en: Act : valid rewrite scenarios where recommendations should be triggered; this metric measures the proportion of correct local code transformations and reflects the model’s ability to identify and complete the next edit.

paragraphs.en: Stay : quiet scenarios where no recommendation is needed; this metric measures whether the model keeps the original code unchanged and reflects its ability to suppress unnecessary suggestions.
paragraphs.zh: 保持安静场景：无需任何推荐的情况；该指标衡量模型是否保持原始代码不变，并反映其抑制不必要建议的能力。

paragraphs.zh: 多行：跨行同步重写场景，例如对函数参数、调用链或重复模式的连续修改；该指标用于衡量模型完成多行编辑的能力。

paragraphs.en: Roll-back : cases where the user has just made a local code change; this metric measures whether the model incorrectly reverts that recent modification and reflects its ability to preserve edit intent and history.

paragraphs.en: For a 140-token rewrite range, diffusion decoding compresses generation from 126 AR steps to about five edit steps, reducing total time from 3964 ms to about 415–420 ms. PIE does not help this short case because both variants are memory-bound at this scale, and the extra suffix-cache bookkeeping and position correction slightly outweigh the saved computation. On the 1024-token long-rewrite setting, approximate suffix-cache reuse through PIE further lowers total time from 784 ms to 676 ms. paragraphs.zh: 在 140 个标记的改写范围内，扩散解码将生成步骤从 126 个 AR 步压缩到大约五个编辑步，使总时间从 3964 毫秒减少到大约 415–420 毫秒。 PIE 在这种情况下并无帮助，因为在这一规模下两种变体都受限于内存，而额外的后缀缓存记录维护和位置校正所消耗的资源略微超过了节省的计算量。 在 1024 个标记的长文本改写设置中，通过 PIE 实现的近似后缀缓存重用进一步将总时间从 784 毫秒降低到 676 毫秒。 这些结果表明，主要的效率提升来自少步并行编辑，而当未变化的后缀较长时，近似后缀缓存重用还能带来额外的端到端优化。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired framework that explicitly models code edit paths. Our study shows that aligning diffusion models with the intrinsic properties of edit prediction, namely locality, incrementality, and context dependence, provides clear advantages over traditional autoregressive methods that regenerate the entire sequence. For edit prediction, these advantages are concentrated in skipping unchanged tokens, editing multiple positions in parallel, and reducing inference latency through approximate KV-Cache reuse, PIE, and multi-token insertion. Our current limitations are that we have not yet developed a deeper theoretical analysis of edit-path diffusion, and our evaluation focuses on latency-critical IDE edit prediction. In the future, we will extend the framework to broader editing settings, including instruction-guided editing, repository-level changes, and agent workflows that combine planning, tool use, and human review.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 Diff Diffusion，一个受扩散模型启发、能够显式建模代码编辑路径的框架。 我们的研究表明，将扩散模型与编辑预测的内在特性（即局部性、增量性和上下文依赖性）对齐，相较于需要重新生成整个序列的传统自回归方法，具有明显的优势。 在编辑预测方面，这些优势主要体现在跳过未更改的标记、并行编辑多个位置，以及通过近似 KV-Cache 重用、PIE 和多标记插入来降低推理延迟。 我们目前的局限性在于，尚未对编辑路径扩散进行更深入的理论分析，且我们的评估主要集中在对延迟敏感的 IDE 编辑预测场景上。 未来，我们将把该框架扩展到更广泛的编辑场景，包括指令引导式编辑、仓库级变更，以及结合规划、工具使用和人工审核的智能体工作流程。

sents.en: Our current limitations are that we have not yet developed a deeper theoretical analysis of edit-path diffusion, and our evaluation focuses on latency-critical IDE edit prediction.
sents.zh: 我们目前的局限性在于，尚未对编辑路径扩散进行更深入的理论分析，且我们的评估主要集中在对延迟敏感的 IDE 编辑预测场景上。

sents.en: In the future, we will extend the framework to broader editing settings, including instruction-guided editing, repository-level changes, and agent workflows that combine planning, tool use, and human review.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have been widely adopted in continuous domains such as image generation [ 36 ] . Recently, discrete diffusion models have emerged as an alternative paradigm for large language models because their denoising process can update multiple positions in parallel rather than following a strict left-to-right order [ 2 ] . Masked diffusion is the dominant formulation, LLaDA and Dream scale this approach to 7B–8B parameters with performance comparable to autoregressive models, and subsequent LLaDA-family work extends it to preference alignment, long-context modeling, multimodal instruction tuning, sparse MoE, and 100B-scale training [ 32 , 46 , 50 , 25 , 47 , 51 , 5 , 4 , 31 ] . More recent work further studies variable-length denoising, insertion/deletion operations, edit-based refinement, and code infilling [ 43 , 26 , 23 , 49 , 15 , 21 , 11 , 3 , 44 , 35 ] . These works show that insertion and deletion operations have become an important direction in dLLM modeling. Diff Diffusion focuses on edit-path modeling from the original snippet to the target snippet, as well as the system-level benefits of this modeling for low-latency tasks. The specific differences are shown in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型已被广泛应用于图像生成等连续领域 [ 36 ] 。 最近，离散扩散模型已成为大语言模型的替代范式，因为其去噪过程可以并行更新多个位置，而不是遵循严格的从左到右的顺序 [ 2 ] 。 掩码扩散是主流形式，LLaDA 和 Dream 将这种方法扩展至 7B–8B 参数规模，其性能可与自回归模型相媲美；后续 LLaDA 系列研究进一步将其拓展到偏好对齐、长上下文建模、多模态指令微调、稀疏 MoE 以及 100B 规模的训练 [ 32 , 46 , 50 , 25 , 47 , 51 , 5 , 4 , 31 ] 。 更近期的研究进一步探讨了可变长度去噪、插入/删除操作、基于编辑的优化以及代码填充 [ 43 , 26 , 23 , 49 , 15 , 21 , 11 , 3 , 44 , 35 ] 。 这些研究表明，插入和删除操作已成为 dLLM 建模的重要方向。 Diff Diffusion 专注于从原始片段到目标片段的编辑路径建模，以及这种建模在低延迟任务中的系统级优势。 具体差异如表 5 所示。

paragraphs.en: LLMs have become a central model family for code intelligence. Proprietary models such as Claude, GPT, and Gemini exhibit strong coding capabilities, while open-source models including Qwen2.5-Coder and Seed-Coder advance code modeling through pretraining on large-scale code corpora, instruction tuning with self-supervised data, commit histories, and evolutionary instructions, and alignment methods such as DPO and GRPO [ 17 , 8 ] . Diffusion-based code models are now emerging alongside these autoregressive systems: proprietary models such as Mercury, Gemini Diffusion, and Seed Diffusion, as well as open-source efforts such as DiffuCoder and Dream-Coder, have shown competitive performance on code-related tasks [ 18 , 13 , 38 , 12 , 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 已成为代码智能领域的核心模型家族。 Claude、GPT 和 Gemini 等专有模型展现出强大的编码能力，而 Qwen2.5-Coder 和 Seed-Coder 等开源模型则通过在大规模代码语料库上进行预训练、利用自监督数据与提交历史及演化指令进行指令调优，以及采用 DPO 和 GRPO 等对齐方法 [ 17 , 8 ] ，推动了代码建模技术的进步。 如今，基于扩散的代码模型正与这些自回归系统一同兴起：Mercury、Gemini Diffusion 和 Seed Diffusion 等专有模型，以及 DiffuCoder 和 Dream-Coder 等开源项目，在代码相关任务中均展现出具有竞争力的性能 [ 18 , 13 , 38 , 12 , 45 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Code editing is an important task in AI-assisted programming, extending the classical program synthesis paradigm to enable fine-grained code modifications. It is widely integrated into popular tools such as Continue, Aider, Copilot, Cursor, and Trae and supports well-known next-edit prediction features, including Cursor Tab and Copilot NES [ 28 , 10 ] . Code editing leverages various forms of software engineering knowledge, including historical edit records, user instructions, and compiler error messages. Numerous benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate model performance. Function-level and file-level benchmarks include C3PO, APEval, CanItEdit, CodeEditorBench, Aider, and HumanEvalFix [ 7 , 19 , 9 , 14 , 1 , 29 ] , while repository-level evaluations include CoEditor and SWE-bench [ 42 , 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 代码编辑是人工智能辅助编程中的一项重要任务，它将经典的程序合成范式扩展为支持精细的代码修改。 该技术已广泛集成到 Continue、Aider、Copilot、Cursor 和 Trae 等流行工具中，并支持广为人知的后续编辑预测功能，包括 Cursor Tab 和 Copilot NES [ 28 , 10 ] 。 代码编辑利用多种形式的软件工程知识，包括历史编辑记录、用户指令和编译器错误信息。 已有大量基准测试被提出用于评估模型性能。 函数级和文件级的基准测试包括 C3PO、APEval、CanItEdit、CodeEditorBench、Aider 和 HumanEvalFix [ 7 , 19 , 9 , 14 , 1 , 29 ] ，而仓库级的评估则包括 CoEditor 和 SWE-bench [ 42 , 20 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In our CT and SFT experiments, we use weighted cross-entropy over edit labels: ordinary token and same predictions use weight 1, while the rarer structural actions insert , delete , and replace use weight 5. Prompt tokens are excluded from the prediction loss. All training stages use the AdamW optimizer, gradient clipping at 1.0, and a warmup-decay learning-rate schedule. For advanced post-training, we first run a reference-only Diff-DPO pass to cache the chosen and rejected transition log-probabilities, then optimize the actor with the Diff-DPO loss using β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 . AGRPO samples G = 8 G=8 complete edit trajectories for each prompt. When a trajectory contains more than 25 denoising steps, 25 transitions are sampled for the policy-gradient estimate, while shorter trajectories optimize all transitions. In our inference settings, the context window is set to 5.5K tokens, the maximum generation length is set to 356 tokens, and the maximum number of iterations is set to 178.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的 CT 和 SFT 实验中，我们对编辑标签使用加权交叉熵：普通词元和相同预测的权重为 1，而更罕见的结构操作（插入、删除和替换）的权重为 5。 提示词元被排除在预测损失之外。 所有训练阶段均使用 AdamW 优化器、梯度裁剪值 1.0 以及预热-衰减学习率调度策略。 对于高级后训练，我们首先运行一个仅参考的 Diff-DPO 流程，以缓存所选和拒绝的转换对数概率，然后使用 β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 通过 Diff-DPO 损失优化智能体。 AGRPO 为每个提示采样 G = 8 G=8 个完整的编辑轨迹。 当一条轨迹包含超过 25 个去噪步骤时，会为策略梯度估计采样 25 个转换；而对于较短的轨迹，则优化所有转换。 在我们的推理设置中，上下文窗口设为 5.5K 词元，最大生成长度设为 356 词元，最大迭代次数设为 178。

paragraphs.en: We conduct an online A/B experiment within an existing IDE edit-prediction feature. Eligible users are randomly assigned to persistent control and treatment groups, which receive the AR baseline and Diff Diffusion, respectively, under the same user-facing configuration. We apply consistent eligibility and validity criteria to both groups and compute aggregate metrics over valid suggestion impressions and successful requests during the evaluation window.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在现有的 IDE 编辑预测功能中开展一项在线 A/B 实验。 符合条件的用户会被随机分配到持续存在的对照组和实验组，这两组在相同面向用户的配置下分别接收 AR 基线模型和 Diff Diffusion 模型。 我们对两组均应用一致的资格和有效性标准，并在评估窗口期间对有效的建议展示和成功请求计算汇总指标。
